input.rationale: Section 4.1 gives each Party a no-cause exit on 90 days' written notice, so the Company's notice period sits within the 60–90 day fallback band and HDI's notice period meets the 90-day floor. Two fallback elements fail, however. First, HDI's notice may specify any Termination Date and is not tied to the end of the then-current term, so HDI can walk away mid-term. Second, the Company's exit is not free: Section 4.2(a) imposes a Termination Payment equal to half of (twelve months' Net Sales less $800,000), an uncapped penalty far exceeding three months of fees. We therefore cap the Termination Payment at three months of fees (leaving the 4.2(b)/(c) mechanics intact) and limit HDI's no-cause termination to the end of the then-current term, landing the clause squarely at the fallback.
